risks.note: The Company states it derives its revenues from the marketing budgets of leading private companies, major Institutions of India, public sector enterprises, multinational companies and Indian brands, and that these budgets 'get refreshed every year'. Revenue therefore has to be re-won annually and is exposed to any cyclical or discretionary cut in client marketing spend.
risks.risk: Dependence on discretionary client marketing budgets that reset each year

risks.note: The Company derived almost 75% of its consolidated revenues from digital services, so group revenue and its high-margin, technology-first model are tied to the continued shift of client spend to digital channels and to the Company keeping pace with digital delivery capability.
risks.risk: Concentration of revenue in digital services

risks.note: Momentum is stated to come from client retention and new business development across three core pillars — Integrated Marketing Communications, Customer Data Analytics & MarTech (Hansa Cequity) and Full-Service Market Research (Hansa Research) — leaving limited diversification if any one discipline loses client traction.
risks.risk: Business concentrated in three service pillars

risks.note: Hansa Research Group Private Limited, Hansa Customer Equity Private Limited and Hansa Direct Private Limited are identified as the Company's material subsidiaries and are subject to separate secretarial audit under Regulation 24A(1); a material part of group performance and compliance exposure therefore sits outside the listed entity.
risks.risk: Reliance on unlisted material subsidiaries for group operations

risks.note: The Board has constituted a Risk Management Committee and adopted a Risk Management Policy, with major risks identified by businesses and functions 'systematically addressed through review and mitigating actions on a continuing basis' and the Audit Committee holding additional oversight of financial risk and controls; the report itself does not enumerate the specific risk factors, limiting external visibility on which exposures management ranks highest.
risks.risk: Risk framework is policy-based rather than an enumerated risk register in this report
